descricao_original: By electron microscopy, the polarized arrangement of cellular structures is evident. These epithelial cells lining a kidney tubule show polarity: the basal regions contains numerous mitochondria; the apical regions contain endocytic vesicles and lysosomes, and extend microvilli that project into the lumen. 6000x
